description: This is a Dart source file defining a provider class 'JobProvider' which manages job postings, including loading nearby jobs and calculating distances using the haversine formula. It includes internal state management and communicates with Flutter's change notifier system.

classes.name: JobProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing a list of JobPost objects, providing methods to load nearby jobs based on geographic coordinates and updating UI components via notifications.

methods.name: loadJobsNear
methods.description: Asynchronously loads sample jobs near a specified location, filtering by maximum distance, and updates internal state with the sorted list of nearby jobs.

methods.name: _haversineKm
methods.description: Computes the distance in kilometers between two geographic coordinates using the haversine formula.
